I. The Prophecy

Two men. One throne. No coincidences.

It is said that before any coin is worth calling a god, its founders must first stand before one. Not to ask for riches — those are given freely to the faithful — but to ask permission to begin.

What was said in that chamber is not written anywhere. What came out of it was a ticker, a symbol, and a promise: that the House would open its doors once, to whoever heard the call first.
